description:
Found while building fz-sc8.72. A fz struct carries no __struct__ at runtime: `dbg(%Pt{x: 1})` prints {1}, `Map.keys(p)` panics with :badmap, and `p.__struct__` panics the host on interp with "schema Pt has no field named __struct__" instead of a diagnostic or a value. In Elixir a struct is a map with __struct__ bound to the module's atom (Elixir.Pt, which since fz-sc8.72 is a value), dbg prints %Pt{x: 1}, Map.keys lists :__struct__ and :x, and p.__struct__ is Pt.

Settle how the struct schema and the one-word map model (.agent/docs/any-value.md) represent the module atom without a second identity (the schema already knows its module), and give the renderer the %Name{} form through render_atom's alias spelling. The exception shape in fz-sc8.61 is a plain map with __struct__ and converges on this. Deviation from Elixir; not needed by the distiller.
title: A struct carries __struct__ and prints as %Name{...}
